statement: Refutation of the proposed inference that a continuous birational section with ordinary local tangent classes everywhere and density-one unit valuations must have a rational tangent class or cofinite unit valuations. A genuine continuous section at the rational place0 has tangent A=product q_j^(j!), locally ordinary everywhere but with infinite sparse valuation support.
where_proved: sections/D_global_route_obstructions.tex, D.20; sparse prime product, local power completion, uniform infinite Kummer cocycle and rational-place decomposition group
depends_on: Tangential splitting of the rational-place decomposition group; elementary Kummer theory; local unit power completion; D.3-D.5 for the distinction from the sufficient cofinite integrality criterion
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.27-31,62v-63; scans56,59-63,126-127; prompt PartD2-D4 and R23
doubtful_reading: No new manuscript reading. The explicitly stated auxiliary inference is refuted, not D1-D4.
notes: The section is genuinely continuous and cuspidal at0. All functions regular and nonzero at0 have their ordinary rational evaluations; t has the nonrational completed tangent value. The obstruction disappears in the proper unramified quotient. Root and finite_field independently checked the construction.

statement: Refutation of a universal rank-zero elliptic-target shortcut for Fermat twists arising from sections: C:x^4+2y^4=3z^4 lies above the rational section t=1/3 and every elliptic target overQ has positive rank. It also has no nonconstant map to an abelian variety with finitely many rational points, or to a positive-genus standard X0(N)/X1(N).
where_proved: sections/D_global_route_obstructions.tex, D.21; three explicit maps, good-prime torsion bounds, V4 orthogonal idempotents and Jacobian isogeny decomposition
depends_on: Milne2021 ChapterII Proposition5.4 and Corollary5.7 for torsion reduction; elementary genus-one isogenies and norm/pullback identities; code/D_Fermat_quartic_certificate.py; Stoll2007 Corollary8.8 and proof for the standard modular-target exclusion
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.27-31,62v-63; scans56,59-63,126-127; prompt PartD3 Fermat twists and the proposed elliptic-quotient route
doubtful_reading: No new manuscript reading. The auxiliary universal rank-zero-target assertion is refuted, not D3 or a section conjecture.
notes: Targets y²=x³−6x, y²=x³−12x, y²=x³+18x receive explicit infinite-order points. Exhaustive finite-field point lists and counts are retained in audit/D_Fermat_quartic_certificate.json. No exact-rank, BSD, or Tate-Shafarevich claim is used. Root reviewed the full construction and the V4 strengthening. The positive-rank elliptic factors also exclude every finite-rational-point abelian target; surjectivity of a nonconstant proper-curve map and Stoll8.8 exclude standard positive-genus modular targets. Thus this actual twist lies outside D22 target hypotheses.

statement: Every section of a hyperbolic curve over a number field whose completion maps nonconstantly to an abelian variety A with finite A(k) and Sha(A)_div=0 is a point or cusp section. In particular this holds overQ for completions mapping nonconstantly to positive-genus standard X0(N) or X1(N), and for sections of U lifting to covers with this property.
where_proved: sections/D_global_route_obstructions.tex, D.22; local point comparison, finite descent, Stoll finite-fibre argument with the real-place errata repair, and Stix finite support
depends_on: D.6 and D.19; Mochizuki2003 Corollary3.13; Harari-Stix2012 Theorem2.1 and Remark2.2(1) in supplied preprint; Stoll2007 Theorem8.2, Proposition8.5, Theorem8.6, Corollary8.8; StollErrata2017 Sections1,3; Stix2015 Corollary5

notes: Real places use connected components via Mochizuki Cor3.13, separately from the p-adic theorem. The finite fibre over one rational modular image contains all finite-place points; no premature assertion about real fibre points is made. Arbitrary arithmetic twists are not shown to have the requisite standard modular or rank-zero abelian target. Root approved the positive derivation and requested full integration.
